find_greenest_time.description: Find the hour with the most green power at a German postcode within the next few hours, to run a dishwasher, charge a car or start a batch job then. Says whether that is now, and how many minutes until it starts.
find_greenest_time.display_name: Find the greenest time to use power

mock_response.summary: The greenest time to use power at 69168 in the next 24 hours is Fri 16 Oct, 17:00 German time (index 91.2).

find_greenest_time.name: find_greenest_time

parameters.description: A five-digit German postcode (Postleitzahl). The figures are for the electricity at that place, so use the postcode where the power is used.

parameters.description: How far ahead to look, from 1 to 96 hours. Defaults to 24. Use a short window, such as 8, for something that has to happen today.

description: Use the GrünstromIndex (Green Power Index) by Corrently to see when electricity at a German postcode is greenest. Get the hourly forecast for the next four days, find the best time to run appliances, check wholesale electricity prices, see which renewables and nearby towns supply the power, get a heat pump schedule and forecast a solar installation's output. Germany only. No account or API key required.
